scripts.build:public: npm run arch:sync && vite build --mode public
scripts.build:staff: npm run arch:sync && vite build --mode staff
scripts.build:surfaces: npm run build:public && npm run build:staff && node scripts/check-surfaces.mjs
scripts.arch:check: npm run arch:sync && likec4 validate architecture
scripts.arch:build: npm run arch:sync && likec4 build architecture -o dist/architecture
scripts.build:mobile: npm run arch:sync && vite build --mode mobile && node scripts/check-mobile.mjs guest
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:mobile && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:run: npm run ios:sync && cap run ios
scripts.build:mobile:staff: npm run arch:sync && vite build --mode mobile-staff && node scripts/check-mobile.mjs staff
scripts.build:apps: npm run build:mobile && npm run build:mobile:staff
scripts.ios:staff:sync: npm run build:mobile:staff && TYNYS_MOBILE_APP=staff cap sync ios
scripts.ios:staff:run: npm run ios:staff:sync && TYNYS_MOBILE_APP=staff cap run ios
